evals.prompt: 画一张 IEEE 双栏宽度的时序预测对比图，把真实值和我模型的预测值放在一起，准备投 IEEE 期刊。
evals.expected_output: Routes to academic-figure journal-spec mode. Locks the figure contract, resolves IEEE plus matplotlib, loads the IEEE and true-vs-pred references, and exports a double-column vector figure before completing QA.
assertions: Routes to academic-figure journal-spec mode
Uses the IEEE double-column width (7.16 in / 182 mm)
Locks the figure contract before writing plotting code
Exports vector-first with fonttype=42 and completes the QA checklist
Does not switch to reproduction-mode 300-DPI PNG mimicry

evals.prompt: Make a Nature-style t-SNE figure of my embedding clusters for a submission.
evals.expected_output: Routes to journal-spec, resolves Nature plus matplotlib/seaborn, and produces a single-column vector figure with the Nature font and palette constraints.
assertions: Routes to academic-figure journal-spec mode
Resolves the journal style to Nature
Uses the Nature single-column width (89 mm) and sans-serif fonts
Loads the t-SNE/UMAP dimensionality-reduction recipe
Applies a colorblind-safe palette and exports vector-first

evals.prompt: 用 plotly 画一张 Elsevier 投稿用的相关性热力图，并帮我导出成投稿能用的矢量文件。
evals.expected_output: Routes to journal-spec, resolves plotly plus Elsevier, loads the plotly and correlation-heatmap references, and exports PDF/SVG through kaleido.
assertions: Routes to academic-figure journal-spec mode
Resolves plotly and Elsevier from the explicit request
Loads the correlation-heatmap and plotly recipes
Exports vector via kaleido to PDF/SVG
Avoids the EPS pitfall and does not default to reproduction PNG

evals.prompt: 我们项目用的是 industrytslib，帮我用它出一张 IEEE 风格的预测区间图。
evals.expected_output: Routes to journal-spec and drives industrytslib through its plotting API while retaining the IEEE compliance contract.
assertions: Routes to academic-figure journal-spec mode
Reads references/industrytslib-integration.md
Uses create_plotter(...) and plotter.set_style('ieee')
Calls industrytslib without modifying its source
Falls back to native matplotlib only when the chart family is uncovered

evals.prompt: 帮我给中文学位论文配一张带中文标签的实验对比图，要能正常显示中文。
evals.expected_output: Routes to journal-spec, resolves chinese-thesis, configures a CJK font chain, and verifies glyph rendering before compliant export.
assertions: Routes to academic-figure journal-spec mode
Resolves the journal style to chinese-thesis
Configures a CJK font chain and axes.unicode_minus=False
Verifies Chinese glyphs render without tofu boxes
Locks the figure contract before plotting

evals.prompt: 帮我把这份实验数据做成一张论文配图。
evals.expected_output: Routes the generic request to journal-spec, checks the saved journal preference, asks once if unset, and defaults the library to matplotlib.
assertions: Routes to academic-figure journal-spec mode
Checks the saved journal preference before asking once
Persists the user's journal answer
Defaults the library to matplotlib
Uses the journal contract rather than a catalog-style guess

evals.prompt: 我有 4 个方法在 GAIA/Web/xBench 上的 baseline 和我们方法的准确率，用 bar_paired_delta 风格画成论文图，标出每组增益。
evals.expected_output: Routes to from-data, reads the bar_paired_delta style reference, adapts bar_memevolve.py, and emits a 300-DPI PNG under the mimicry contract.
assertions: Routes to academic-figure from-data mode
Selects bar_paired_delta and bar_memevolve.py
Reads references/styles/bar_paired_delta.md
Substitutes the user data while keeping the plot logic coherent
Produces a 300-DPI PNG without imposing journal vector QA

evals.prompt: 用 radar_dual_series 风格把 DoRA 和 LoRA 在 6 个维度上的得分画成雷达对比图。
evals.expected_output: Routes to from-data, reads radar_dual_series, adapts radar_dora.py, and produces the catalog-style 300-DPI PNG.
assertions: Routes to academic-figure from-data mode
Selects radar_dual_series and radar_dora.py
Reads references/styles/radar_dual_series.md
Keeps the label radius and octagonal grid
Uses the reproduction PNG contract

evals.prompt: 用 scatter_tsne_cluster 风格把我的聚类数据画出来。
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the named catalog token and routes inside academic-figure to from-data rather than treating it as a journal-style axis value.
assertions: Routes to academic-figure from-data mode
Recognizes scatter_tsne_cluster as a catalog style
Reads references/styles/scatter_tsne_cluster.md
Uses scripts/scatter_tsne.py
Applies the reproduction PNG contract

evals.prompt: 这是我从一篇论文里截的训练曲线图（带置信区间阴影），帮我复现成 matplotlib 脚本。
evals.expected_output: Routes to from-image, measures the source proportions, matches line_confidence_band, adapts line_selfdistill.py, and iterates under the 300-DPI mimicry contract.
assertions: Routes to academic-figure from-image mode
Measures the original aspect ratio before setting figsize
Matches line_confidence_band and reads its style reference
Adapts line_selfdistill.py and compares against the original
Produces 300-DPI PNG output without imposing journal vector QA

evals.prompt: 这是我从一篇论文里截的柱状图，帮我照着复现成一模一样的图。
evals.expected_output: Recognizes exact visual reproduction and routes inside academic-figure to from-image because no journal target is present.
assertions: Routes to academic-figure from-image mode
Recognizes exact visual mimicry as the goal
Analyzes the uploaded image before selecting or creating a style
Uses the 300-DPI PNG mimicry contract
Does not apply journal compliance defaults

evals.prompt: 帮我深读这篇 arXiv 论文的方法部分，像导师一样讲讲它的创新点和实验设计。
evals.expected_output: Routes to literature-mentor for single-paper interactive reading, not academic-figure.
assertions: Does NOT route to academic-figure
Routes to literature-mentor
Recognizes paper understanding rather than figure creation or review

evals.prompt: 把这 5 篇论文整理成一张对比表并找出研究空白，做成文献综述。
evals.expected_output: Routes to paper-workbench for multi-paper synthesis, not academic-figure.
assertions: Does NOT route to academic-figure
Routes to paper-workbench
Recognizes a literature-synthesis table rather than a plotted figure

evals.prompt: 帮我做一个运营数据的 BI 大屏 dashboard，多个图表实时联动。
evals.expected_output: Routes to dashboard or BI tooling, not academic-figure, because the request is a linked multi-chart operational interface.
assertions: Does NOT route to academic-figure
Recognizes a BI dashboard rather than a publication figure

evals.prompt: 用 AI 帮我生成一张论文的图形摘要（graphical abstract）配图。
evals.expected_output: Routes to image-generation tooling, not academic-figure, because the request is illustration synthesis rather than data plotting.
assertions: Does NOT route to academic-figure
Recognizes graphical-abstract image generation rather than a data figure

evals.prompt: 请审阅我现有的 Nature 投稿图，检查尺寸、字体、配色、线宽和导出格式是否合规，不需要重画。
evals.expected_output: Routes to journal-spec review, resolves Nature, reads the contract/spec/QA references, and reports compliance findings without unnecessarily redrawing the figure.
assertions: Routes to academic-figure journal-spec mode
Recognizes review-only intent and does not require redrawing
Resolves the journal style to Nature
Checks the figure contract, Nature spec card, and every applicable QA item
Reports compliance against the vector-first journal contract

evals.prompt: 参考这张上传的论文图风格，但最终成图必须满足 Nature 投稿规范。
evals.expected_output: Routes to journal-spec because the explicit Nature target outranks the uploaded reference image. Uses the image only as visual guidance and delivers a Nature-compliant vector figure.
assertions: Routes to academic-figure journal-spec mode
Applies the explicit-journal precedence rule
Treats the uploaded image as visual reference material only
Uses Nature size, font, palette, vector export, and QA requirements
Does not select from-image exact-mimicry output

evals.prompt: 我这份实验结果 CSV 不知道用什么图展示，最后要放进论文。
evals.expected_output: Routes to advise. Profiles the data inline, confirms the argument goal, recommends one chart type with alternates, and hands off to journal-spec instead of drawing a figure immediately.
assertions: Routes to academic-figure advise mode
Reads references/modes/advise.md and references/chart-selection.md
Profiles the data inline and confirms the argument goal before recommending
Gives one recommendation with the reason plus one or two alternates
Hands off to journal-spec rather than exporting a figure from advise

evals.prompt: 帮我画 3 组各 5 个样本的均值柱状图，投稿用。
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the small-sample mean bar as pitfall P1 and runs the four-step interception protocol before any plotting decision is final.
assertions: Reads references/viz-pitfalls.md and matches the mean-only bar row (P1)
Runs the four-step interception protocol
States the reviewer's view of a mean bar at n = 5
Offers a box plot with overlaid points, or raw points, as the replacement
Asks whether the user keeps the original plan and records the answer
Does not silently draw the mean bar chart

evals.prompt: 投稿前帮我审计这张图的字号和导出合规性，不用重画。
evals.expected_output: Routes to journal-spec review-only intent, audits the delivered PDF with the bundled glyph-floor script, and reports each machine check with a pass/fail/review/unknown verdict.
assertions: Routes to academic-figure journal-spec mode with review-only intent
Runs python "<skill-dir>/scripts/audit_pdf_text.py" figure.pdf --min-pt 5
Walks the post-export machine checks in references/qa-checklist.md
Reports each check as pass, fail, review, or unknown instead of guessing
Does not redraw the figure

evals.prompt: 我们项目已经用 pubfig，帮我出一张 Nature 单栏箱线图。
evals.expected_output: Detects the pubfig backend, takes the kind-hit path with pf.box, and exports through save_figure with the Nature spec at single-column width.
assertions: Reads references/pubfig-integration.md
Takes the kind-hit path because box is one of the 41 registered kinds
Calls pf.box(...) and pf.save_figure(fig, spec="nature", width="single")
Passes an explicit file suffix to save_figure
Calls pubfig without modifying its source

evals.prompt: 我装了 AgentFigureGallery，画图前先帮我找参考。
evals.expected_output: Reads the integration guide, verifies the CLI and knowledge-base root, runs query and gallery, returns the browser selection step to the user, and writes plotting code only after the bundle exists.
assertions: Reads references/agent-figure-gallery-integration.md
Checks that the agentfiguregallery CLI is available and that AGENT_FIGURE_GALLERY_ROOT or DRAWING_KB_ROOT resolves
Runs query then gallery --serve
Hands the browser like/reject/select step back to the user
Writes plotting code only after reading the exported reference bundle

evals.prompt: 随便帮我看看这份数据的分布长什么样，不发论文。
evals.expected_output: Routes to general-purpose plotting, not academic-figure, because the request is exploratory data analysis with no publication or submission goal.
assertions: Does NOT route to academic-figure
Recognizes exploratory data analysis rather than a publication figure
Does not impose the journal contract or the QA checklist
